chapter.verse: Tu-in leitung buppi in kampau khat leh kammal tawm nei hi.
Amaute nisuahna lamah lal uh a, Shinar gamsungah zanglei mun khat mu uh a, tua lai-ah teng uh hi.
Amaute khat leh khat kiangah, “Hong pai un, leiseek seekin lim takin hal ni,” kici uh hi. Amaute in suang taangin leiseek nei uh a, a buan dingin kultal tui nei uh hi.

Tua ciangin amaute in, “Hong pai un, leitung buppi maitang-ah eite i kithehthang gawp loh nadingin ei’ adingin khuapi khat bawlin, a dawn in vantung a ban ding tausangpi khat lamin, eite’ min ding khat bawl ni,” ci uh hi.
Mihingte’ lamsa khuapi leh tausangpi a en dingin Topa hong paisuk hi.
Topa in, “En un, amaute in mikhat hi uh a, amaute khempeuh in kampau khat nei uh hi; hih in amau’ sep ding a kipatna bek ahi hi; tu-in sep dinga amau vaihawmte amau’ adingin hi thei nawn lo ding hi.
Hong pai un, amaute khat leh khat’ thugen a kitheih loh nadingun eite paisukin amau’ kampau va kitukalhsak ni,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in tua lai panin leitung maitang khempeuhah amaute thehthang a, amaute in akhuapi bawl uh tawp uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a min Babel kici hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in tua munah leitung khempeuh kampau kitukalhsak hi; tua lai mun panin Topa in leitung maitang khempeuh' tungah amaute thehthang hi.
Hihte in Shem’ suan-le-khakte' tangthu ahi hi. Shem kum zakhat a phak, tuiciin khit kum nih ciangin, amah in Arpakshad kici tapa khat nei hi;
Arpakshad a suah khit ciangin Shem kum zanga nungta a, tapa leh tanu dang nei lai hi.
Arpakshad kum sawmthum-le-nga a nuntak khit ciangin, amah in Shelah kici tapa khat nei hi;
Shelah a suah khit ciangin Arpakshad kum zali leh kum thum nungta a, tapa leh tanu dang nei lai hi.
Shelah kum sawmthum a nuntak khit ciangin amah in Eber kici tapa khat nei hi;
Eber’ suah khit ciangin Shelah kum zali leh kum thum nungta a, tapa leh tanu dang nei lai hi.
Eber kum sawmthum-le-li a nuntak khit ciangin amah in Peleg kici tapa khat nei hi;
Peleg suah khit ciangin Eber kum zali leh kum sawmthum nungta a, tapa leh tanu dang nei lai hi.
Peleg kum sawmthum a nuntak khit ciangin amah in Re-u kici tapa khat nei hi;
Re-u a suah khit ciangin Peleg kum zanih leh kum kua nungta a, tapa leh tanu dang nei lai hi.
Re-u kum sawmthum-le-nih a nuntak khit ciangin amah in Serug kici tapa khat nei hi;
Serug’ suah khit ciangin Re-u kum zanih leh kum sagih nungta a, tapa leh tanu dang nei lai hi.
Serug kum sawmthum a nuntak khit ciangin amah in Nahor kici tapa khat nei hi;
Nahor’ suah khit ciangin Serug kum zanih nungta a, tapa leh tanu dang nei lai hi.
Nahor kum sawmnih-le-kua a nuntak khit ciangin amah in Terah kici tapa khat nei hi;
Terah’ suah khit ciangin Nahor kum za leh kum sawm-le-kua nungta a, tapa leh tanu dang nei lai hi.
Terah kum sawmsagih a nuntak khit ciangin amah in tapa Abram, Nahor, leh Haran nei hi.
Tu-in hihte in Terah’ suan-le-khakte tangthu ahi hi. Terah in Abram, Nahor leh Haran’ pa ahi hi; Haran in Lot’ pa ahi hi.
Ama' pa Terah’ a sih ma-in ama suahna gam ahi Khaldea gam Ur khua-ah Haran si hi.
Abram leh Nahor in zi nei uh hi; Abram’ zi’ min in Sarai hi a, Nahor’ zi’ min in Milkah hi-in Haran’ tanu ahi hi. Haran in Milkah leh Iskah-te’ pa ahi hi.
Tu-in Sarai ciing hi; amah in ta nei lo hi.

Terah in ama' tapa Abram leh Haran’ tapa Lot, ama' tupa leh a tapa Abram’ zi ahi a monu Sarai la-in, Kanaan gamsungah pai dingin Khaldea gam Ur khua panin amaute paikhia khawm uh hi; ahih hangin amaute Haran a tun’ uh ciangin tua munah teng uh hi.
Terah’ khan’ sung in kum zanih leh kum nga ahi hi; Haran-ah Terah si hi.
